description:
Create a new GeoPackage vector layer to track sensor deployments.

1. Open the 'New GeoPackage Layer' tool (Layer > Create Layer > New GeoPackage Layer).
2. Database path: /home/ga/GIS_Data/sensor_network.gpkg
3. Table name: 'sensors'
4. Geometry type: Point
5. Coordinate Reference System: EPSG:4326 - WGS 84
6. Add two new fields to the fields list:
   - Name: 'model_id', Type: Text (String)
   - Name: 'install_year', Type: Integer (Whole Number)
7. Click OK to create the layer.
8. Toggle Editing on the new 'sensors' layer.
9. Add a point feature anywhere in the San Francisco area.
10. In the feature attributes form, enter:
    - model_id: 'EnvSense-X1'
    - install_year: 2024
11. Save Layer Edits (click the Save icon or Layer > Save Layer Edits) to ensure data is written to disk.
